# Voting in the Saṁgha

<!-- STEP id="debate-first" -->
## Debate and Discussion

The **Bauddha Saṁgha** was a monastic community, a group of monks, established by Gautama Buddha. The Saṁgha encouraged debate and discussion among its members.

<!-- STEP id="vote-next" -->
## Then the Vote

Its members could choose their leader and make decisions through voting.

**The Saṁgha shows collective decision-making in practice.**
